headline: Washburn keep Central Missouri scoreless again
dek: Washburn won their eighteenth match in 22 by beating Central Missouri, and no other programme in the conference has won as many. They have conceded seven goals all season, and Central Missouri have yet to score against them this season.

pattern.label: derived
pattern.text: The drop from the top is steep rather than gradual: Washburn have more goals than Newman, Missouri Southern and Fort Hays State together.

wire.line: Pittsburg State have conceded four goals all season and lost once, to Washburn.

findings.label: observed
findings.text: Four matches are past their date with no result; Missouri Southern are in every one but Washburn's meeting with Baker.

findings.label: derived
findings.text: Central Missouri have conceded eight goals in 22 matches while scoring 49.

findings.label: derived
findings.text: Eighteen different players have scored for Pittsburg State.

findings.label: observed
findings.text: Coryn Jespersen has 17 assists for Central Missouri, to go with four goals.

findings.label: observed
findings.text: Juliette Langlet has made 121 saves for Northeastern State and conceded 18 goals.

last_match.line: Central Missouri have now lost to both Pittsburg State and Washburn this month.

next_match.line: Each side's only defeat this season came against the other.

validation.policy: observed and derived claims are recomputed against the data home before publish; failures are dropped, not softened. signal and projected pass on schema unless the data contradicts a figure. context is never validated as a finding.
